text:
Liang: FYI preflight stoplight ran for release v2026.3 — red on prompt-suite PS-2026-03-21-1. Need quick decision on release window.

DevBot: AUTO-CHECK RESULTS:
- prompt-suite: ps-2026-03-21-1
- fail_count: 18/400 (4.5%) threshold 2%
- top regression: hallucination_rate +4.2% (baseline 1.1%)
- low-confidence answers up 3.1%
- rollout candidates: v2026.3 (canary) vs fallback v2026.2
- recommended action: hold and triage (see /ops link)

Maria: ugh, that's above our soft threshold. Is this isolated to summarizer or across routes?

Liang: looks concentrated on summarizer and long-context Q/A route. Short-chat routes are fine.

Josh: can we pin summarizer model to v2026.2 for the release and let other routes go? How painful is a per-route pin for this deploy?

Ava: change window tonight at 23:00 UTC. If we decide to split routes, we need release notes updated + ops signoff by 22:15 UTC.

Sam: Pinning summarizer is doable: `releasebot pin-route --route summarizer --from v2026.3 --to v2026.2` — I've tested the command in staging. Minimal config churn.

OpsTeam: If you pin, we need a quick smoke on EU region after pin to ensure latency isn't impacted. We can run a short sweep at 22:25 UTC.

Maria: Can we bisect the prompt-suite? Maybe one of the new prompt templates regressed. If it's a prompt issue we could hotfix faster.

Liang: good idea. I'm running a narrowed run now: `prompt-eval run --suite ps-2026-03-21-1 --split-by template`

DevBot: NARROWED RUN READY — results in 9m. Top offender: template T-7 shows +8% hallucination.

Josh: T-7 was introduced in PR #8421 (author @Maria). Maria can you confirm the intent?

Maria: yep I added T-7 to improve concision for long contexts. I can revert it quickly if we want.

Ava: Options: 1) revert T-7 and proceed with v2026.3 (risk: may need additional QA), 2) pin summarizer to v2026.2 and deploy other routes, 3) abort tonight and wait for next window (48h). Which gets ops and product signoff?

Liang: preference for option 2 to preserve most of the release benefits and buy time for a proper revert + test.

Sam: agree. I can patch the release manifest and run the pin command. Will also open a small rollback runbook entry so SREs have steps.

OpsTeam: We'll prepare the smoke tests. If pin is applied, we expect no infra change; smoke should pass in ~5m.

Maria: I'll open PR to revert T-7 right after the pin so we can test the reverted prompt in canary tomorrow.

Josh: product ok with partial route pin? @Ava

Ava: Product signs off on partial pin. Please include a short note in release_notes: "Summarizer temporarily pinned to v2026.2 due to prompt regression; full release to follow after prompt revert testing."

DevBot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- ticket #RELEASE-4987: partial pin summarizer -> v2026.2 (owner Sam)
- ticket #PROMPT-297: revert template T-7 (owner Maria)
- smoke-run scheduled 22:25 UTC (OpsTeam)

Liang: I'll update the release checklist and mark the gate as "soft-blocked -> partial-accept".

Sam: executing pin now: `releasebot pin-route --route summarizer --target v2026.2 && releasebot annotate --ticket RELEASE-4987 "pinned before 23:00 UTC window"`

DevBot: PIN CONFIRMED by releasebot at 3459876580. Route summarizer -> v2026.2.

OpsTeam: running EU smoke now.

DevBot: SMOKE RESULTS: latency nominal, error rate unchanged, basic correctness quick-check pass.

Ava: OK, proceeding with the rest of the release on schedule. Maria, follow up on the revert PR and coordinate a re-eval.

Maria: will do. Thanks team.

Josh: leaving a short note in the changelog and release notes per Ava's text.

Liang: closing loop: mark release as partially gated; full rollout pending prompt revert and re-eval. Good work. :thumbsup:
